note: DEPTH-study exploration questions. Posed to CE (fixed corpus, no new sources) to drive new analysis docs; the wiki accumulates syntheses RAG structurally cannot. Authored to be DISTINCT from the held-out eval set (compounding_queries.json) — they probe facets the eval never asks (evaluation, data, limitations, terminology, disclosure) plus a few theme-adjacent angles (flagged), so they do NOT pre-answer any eval query. Analyses are full native CE (including CE's model-knowledge/further-directions section — the closed-book arm controls for that). Frozen; a hash is recorded per run.

queries.q: What evaluation benchmarks and metrics recur across the papers, and where do they agree or differ on what counts as progress?
How do the papers differ in training-data strategy — sources, filtering, and mixture?
What limitations or open problems do the authors acknowledge in their own work?
What recurring terms are defined differently or inconsistently across the papers?
What does each open-weight release disclose versus withhold (weights, data, code, training recipe)?
What genealogy of ideas connects the papers — which build on or react to which?
How do the reasoning-and-acting methods differ in their use of feedback, search, and memory?
How do the papers describe the compute/hardware regimes they target (training vs inference)?
What ablation studies appear across the corpus, and which components do they identify as load-bearing?
How do the papers address deployment, serving, or productionization concerns?
What safety and governance considerations recur, and what mitigations do the authors propose?
Which baselines do the papers compare against, and how are their headline improvements framed?
What assumptions about tokenization and input representation do the papers share or differ on?
How do the papers define and measure task success or helpfulness?
What claims do the papers make about transfer or generalization beyond their training tasks?
How do the papers position their contribution relative to the broader research landscape at the time?
